text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 36 vials of zoledronic acid 4 mg/100 mL with 3.3 vials used daily, providing 11 days of supply. Corvale General holds 89 vials with 2.8 vials used daily, providing 31.7 days of supply. The current product label (NDC 68083014201) identifies Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) in India as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show zoledronic acid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection 1244548 at the Gland Pharma plant concluded on 2024-07-25 and received a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification, which was made known on 2025-01-15.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is low and requires replenishment. Corvale General has adequate supply for the near term. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. as the primary alternative source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify AuroMedics Pharma LLC, Avenacy Inc., BPI Labs LLC, and BluePoint Laboratories as backup suppliers; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage at both sites and update inventory projections weekly; requires Inventory Manager approval.
4. Buyer to request updated plant information from all alternative suppliers for supply chain transparency; requires Quality Assurance approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications are recommended by the buyer; such decisions rest with the treating clinicians and the committee.
